Contingency Fee: Most reputable Chicago personal injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis (no upfront costs, and they only get paid a percentage if you win or settle). Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers +2
Trial Experience: Some firms settle cases quickly out of court, while others (like Disparti or Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard) maintain an active courtroom presence if insurance companies refuse fair offers. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. +1
Statute of Limitations: Generally 2 years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit in Illinois (5 years for property damage).
Comparative Fault: Illinois uses a modified comparative fault rule, meaning you can recover compensation as long as you are 50% or less at fault (though your recovery is reduced by your percentage of fault). Malman Law +1
